The '''Maximum Security Tech Center''' was a maintenance and technology facility in the [[Prison Tech Station]] in the [[Maximum Security Section]], a sector of the [[Belsavis prison]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[invasion of Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]], a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] searching for [[Zale Barrows]] brought the remains of Barrows' [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[M3-OB]] to the tech center, where the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Skadge]] and the hunter forced some technicians to repair the [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Maximum Security Tech Center is a class-restricted area on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where the Bounty Hunter class mission "Mnemonia" occurs.<ref name="TOR" />
